title: Transfer latest: Newcastle sign Osula, West Ham’s Zouma agrees UAE move
trail: Newcastle have signed the striker William Osula from Sheffield United and Kurt Zouma is heading for a medical at Shabab Al-Ahli
body: Newcastle have signed the Denmark Under-21s striker Will Osula from Sheffield United for an undisclosed fee, understood to be an initial £10m. The 21-year-old played 21 times in the Premier League last season without scoring, having spent the previous campaign on loan at Derby in League One. Osula began his career at his hometown club FC Copenhagen before moving to the Blades in 2018. Newcastle’s manager, Eddie Howe, said: “William is a talented young forward with all the attributes to be an exciting player for Newcastle United. We have watched his development closely and we are delighted to have the opportunity to work with him in this next step in his career.” The West Ham defender Kurt Zouma has agreed a move to the UAE Pro League side Shabab Al-Ahli and will travel for a medical. The 29-year-old made 33 Premier League appearances last season but would not be guaranteed game time under Julen Lopetegui and has decided to leave after a decade in England’s top flight. Zouma cost West Ham almost £30m from Chelsea in 2021 but is set to go for a nominal amount, helping Lopetegui free up wages and a space in the squad after the signing of six players, including the £40m Maximilian Kilman from Wolves. Zouma won two Premier League titles, the Champions League and the League Cup with Chelsea, and added a Europa Conference League winner’s medal in 2023. Chelsea have signed the Boca Juniors defender Aaron Anselmino for an undisclosed fee, with the 19-year-old loaned back to the Argentinian side for the 2024-25 season. He has signed a seven-year Chelsea contract after making 10 appearances for Boca.
